g.text: Welcome to The Queen’s Medical Center
The color- and symbol-coded elevators and coordinating
signage are designed to help patients and visitors find their
way around the Medical Center campus. Follow the signs to
the elevator that has the closest access to your destination.
Access to all elevators is available on Levels 1 and 4.
Please note: ‘Iolani Elevator is not wheelchair accessible
on Level 1. Accessible routes to Level 1 destinations are
available by using Queen Emma Elevator.
